_comment: MCP server configuration for Ailin CI. Loaded by mcp-client-service.ts when MCP_SERVERS_CONFIG is not set, AND only when MCP_CLIENT_ENABLED=true (ADR-024). Ships EMPTY on purpose: enabling the client must not, by itself, connect anything.
_security: The previous default declared a filesystem server rooted at /app (the deployed application tree, including its source) with safeForStrategies=true, exposed to every orchestration strategy. It was dormant in production only because tsc does not copy .json into dist/ — a build accident, not a control. Any server added here must scope its root to a scratch directory, never the app tree, and should leave safeForStrategies=false unless the tools are genuinely safe for autonomous strategy use.
